name: Blackrock Pass
summary: At Blackrock Pass, a heavy iron gate marks the road from Redridge Mountains into the Burning Steppes. The corridor runs north beneath the cliffs, from human heartlands to the war grounds of Dark Iron dwarves and Blackrock orcs. Travelers on foot cross a harsh frontier.

sections.title: A Scorched Threshold
sections.body: Blackrock Pass cuts through the mountains between Redridge Mountains and the Burning Steppes. A heavy iron gate marks the rocky boundary, beyond the forests and lakes of the southern valleys. South of the gate, Lakeshire's beleaguered militia protects pastoral lands. North of it, fire elementals, dragonkin, and hostile orc warbands fill an open wasteland. Few cross on foot unless bound for the shadow of Blackrock Mountain itself.

aliases: path from redridge to burning steppes
faq.answer: Blackrock Pass leads from the northern border of Redridge Mountains into the southern perimeter of the Burning Steppes. It is a direct overland gateway between the southern Alliance territories and the foothills of Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: Is it safe for travelers from Lakeshire to cross the pass?
aliases: can i go through blackrock pass
faq.answer: No. The lands north of the pass are far more dangerous than the hills around Redridge. Ferocious Blackrock orcs, giant fire elementals, and black whelps make the Burning Steppes hazardous for low-level adventurers and common wayfarers.

Neither Stormwind nor the Horde holds full control over Blackrock Pass. Blackrock orcs and wild beasts press in on the sparsely fortified chokepoint, while Redridge town guards watch from below with deep dread.

angles.text: For Redridge's defenders and the Kingdom of Stormwind, Blackrock Pass is a constant source of dread. It offers Blackrock orcs a straight path south into human lands.
